records.title: Flinders International Postgraduate Research Scholarship (FIPRS)
records.deadline_display: Applications close Thursday 18 June 2026 Australian Central Standard Time (2027 HDR Annual Scholarship Round - International).
records.application_period: 2027 HDR Annual Scholarship Round - International: opened 30 April 2026, closed 18 June 2026; applicants must first lodge an HDR admission application and then a scholarship application.

records.title: University of Otago Global Scholarships
records.deadline_display: Opening date 1 May in year prior to study for offshore students, 1 July for onshore students. Closing dates 10 December for semester 1 (February) start, 30 April for semester 2 (July) start for offshore students, 15 August for onshore students.
records.application_period: Applications open 1 May in the year prior to study for offshore students (1 July for onshore students) and close 10 December for a Semester 1 (February) start, or 30 April for a Semester 2 (July) start for offshore students.

records.title: Vice-Chancellor's Scholarships for International Students
records.deadline_display: Opening date 1 May in year prior to study for offshore students, 1 July for onshore students. Closing dates 10 December for semester 1 (February) start, 30 April for semester 2 (July) start for offshore students, 15 August for onshore students.
records.application_period: Applications open 1 May in the year prior to study for offshore students (1 July for onshore students) and close 10 December for a Semester 1 (February) start, or 30 April for a Semester 2 (July) start for offshore students.

records.title: University of Otago International Academic Excellence Scholarships
records.deadline_display: Invited to apply in eVision, after you have accepted any previous scholarship offer (e.g. Vice Chancellor's International Scholarship, Global Scholarship). Required to complete scholarship application questions and information as requested.
records.application_period: Invitation-based, following acceptance of an earlier Otago international scholarship offer during admission processing

records.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Sciences Po (Graduate Level)
records.deadline_display: Applications for the fee waiver will be open from October to mid-December 2026; the scholarship's own application deadline has not yet been published on the programme page.
records.application_period: 2027 intake. Application fee waiver window October to mid-December 2026; information sessions between September and December 2026; virtual Open House 17 October 2026; Sciences Po international graduate procedure deadline 21 February 2027 (11.59pm Paris time) for the 2027 intake.

records.title: Vice-Chancellor's Scholarship for International Students
records.official_source: University of Otago | Ōtākou Whakaihu Waka
records.deadline_display: Opening dates: 1 May in the year prior to study for offshore students; 1 July for onshore students. Closing dates: 10 December for semester 1 (February) start; 30 April for semester 2 (July) start for offshore students; 15 August for onshore students.
records.application_period: Annual cycles with applicant-type and semester-specific windows. Offshore students: apply 1 May (year prior) to 30 April for a semester 2 start, or to 10 December for a semester 1 start. Onshore students: apply 1 July to 15 August.

records.title: University of Otago International Master's Research Scholarship
records.official_source: University of Otago | Ōtākou Whakaihu Waka
records.deadline_display: No fixed closing date: 'Applicants can apply anytime but applications will be reviewed four times a year (1 March, 1 June, 1 September and 1 November)'.
records.application_period: Continuous applications accepted year-round, with assessment rounds on 1 March, 1 June, 1 September and 1 November.

records.title: University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship
records.deadline_display: Applicants can apply anytime; applications are considered at quarterly rounds held in March, June, September and November. Applications must be submitted via eVision with a completed departmental assessment by the first day of each round month.
records.application_period: Year-round submissions, assessed at quarterly rounds (March, June, September, November)
